nodes.label: Isolated custom package build
nodes.rationale: Custom packages are never executed in the builder runtime to protect builder secrets, database access, and host resources.

nodes.label: Builder and built-site design-system separation
nodes.rationale: Builder UI CSS must not leak into the sandboxed built-site canvas, and generated sites must not require builder UI styling.

nodes.label: Self-hosted font imports
nodes.rationale: Self-hosting avoids runtime font-CDN requests, privacy and consent concerns, and can improve performance.
